study_identification_part.si4_title: Mapping Neurophysiological Subtypes of Major Depressive Disorder Using Normative Models of the Functional Connectome

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Quantify individual-level deviations in functional connectivity strength (FCS) across the lifespan in MDD using normative modeling, and identify reproducible neurophysiological MDD subtypes and their clinical relevance, including prediction of antidepressant response.

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Normative modeling of FCS revealed substantial individual heterogeneity in MDD; two reproducible neurophysiological subtypes emerged with opposing deviation patterns and distinct clinical features, and baseline deviations predicted treatment response in the severe-deviation subtype.
